title: Fix Your MSFS Helicopter Controls! Thrustmaster T.16000M & TWCS Complete Setup
description:
Struggling to keep a helicopter steady in Microsoft Flight Simulator? You are not alone. Flying rotary-wing aircraft with default fixed-wing bindings is nearly impossible: the collective is inverted, control curves cause massive lag, and twisting the joystick bleeds unwanted yaw straight into your cyclic.

In this complete step-by-step setup guide, we build dedicated helicopter profiles from scratch for the Thrustmaster T.16000M FCS joystick and TWCS throttle.

Learn how to configure your cyclic, set up your collective properly, bind the anti-torque rocker, handle governor and trim toggles, adjust sensitivity deadzones, and export/import clean controller profiles.
